description: Energy system model data for "Climate2Energy: a framework to consistently include climate change risk into energy system modeling is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Leonard Göke (ETH Zürich). This dataset provides the input data, code, and results of the energy system model in "Climate2Energy: a framework to consistently include climate change risk into energy system modeling". The time-series input data computed by the Climate2Energy tool and converted into the input format of the energy model is located in the "timeSeries" folder. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
